conditions.scope: Tide FishingInfoManager nearby placed informational block scan

change.summary: Read nearby Tide informational blocks only from already loaded chunks during the server tick.

before.scan: Tide calls ServerLevel.getBlockState at each of 13 by 7 by 13 nearby positions when the player's informational data refreshes.
before.missing_chunk: The server may synchronously load or generate an absent chunk and block its tick thread.

after.loaded_chunk: Confirm the full chunk is already loaded, then use the original ServerLevel block-state read and keep Tide's native informational-block result.
after.missing_chunk: Treat the scanned position as AIR for this refresh without requesting or generating a chunk. A later refresh can observe it after normal loading.

modifiers.notes: The guard changes only the block read inside Tide's installed nearby informational scan. It does not alter registered blocks, fishing items, recipes, world data or ordinary block queries.

rationale.purpose: Prevent Tide's periodic informational scan from blocking the server tick on chunk generation while preserving its results for loaded blocks.
rationale.decision_source: User reported inability to join on 2026-10-26. The local 18:05 watchdog crash trace and the exact installed Tide 2.1.1 bytecode identify the unguarded block read. The installed Tide server config has no switch for this scan.

introduced.summary: Add a version-gated, nonblocking loaded-chunk read to Tide's nearby informational-block scan.

history.summary: Keep the installed Tide 2.1.1 scan inside loaded chunks after its synchronous chunk request caused a local watchdog crash.

relations: Loaded informational blocks keep the native Tide result
Missing chunks remain on Minecraft's normal loading path and can be observed on a later Tide refresh
notes: The installed informational block tag contains tide:lunar_calendar and tide:weather_radio.
The original static registry facts and Tide's recipe graph remain unchanged.
unresolved: Player rejoin and sustained server uptime after this source change remain unobserved under the project's gameplay-test restriction.
